mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mdf_industry_membership (taxonomy_code, industry_code, industry_name, canonical_symbol, effective_from, effective_to, source_provider, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.taxonomyCode}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.industryName}, #{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.effectiveFrom}, #{item.effectiveTo}, #{item.sourceProvider}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE industry_name = VALUES(industry_name), effective_to = VALUES(effective_to), source_provider = VALUES(source_provider), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_industry_membership m1 JOIN mdf_industry_membership m2 ON m1.taxonomy_code = m2.taxonomy_code AND m1.canonical_symbol = m2.canonical_symbol AND m1.id < m2.id WHERE m1.taxonomy_code = #{taxonomyCode} AND m1.effective_from < COALESCE(m2.effective_to, '9999-12-31') AND m2.effective_from < COALESCE(m1.effective_to, '9999-12-31')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_industry_membership WHERE taxonomy_code = #{taxonomyCode}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_symbol) FROM mdf_industry_membership WHERE taxonomy_code = #{taxonomyCode}
